rows.en:
So, it's finally my turn...
Nice to meet you all.
My name is Shoji Arai.
I'm a second-year.{p}This is rather sudden, but...
Do you all believe in past lives?{p}Do you think reincarnation exists?
I think it exists
I don't think it exists
There's no way to know that

Rebirth... It's also called the transmigration of souls.
Remembering who and where you were in a former life, or knowing in detail the past of a stranger you couldn't possibly know about...
Strange phenomena like that happen all over the world.
They aren't things that only happen in movies and TV dramas.
...The reason I say so is that I myself carry memories of my own past life.{p}You find that hard to believe?
{a}...
I can believe it
I can't believe it

I see.
So you're telling me you can believe it.
Well now, that makes me happy.
You're the first person who's ever said that to me, {a}.
When I bring this up out of the blue, most people get a suspicious look in their eyes and drift away from me...
Um... {a}.
Would you shake my hand?
I'm deeply moved right now.{p}Moved by you, {a}, for believing my story when we've only just met...
I don't mind shaking hands
I don't want to shake hands

...Ah, I will never forget the warmth of this hand.
Anyway, please listen to my story.
I still have memories of my past life.
...Yes, I remember them clearly.
Everything, from the time I first became aware of the world in my past life, through my death, until I was born anew...
Did you know?{p}

In that cradle-like space, I thought about one thing the whole time.
About the life I'd led until then...
In other words... about my life in my past life.
In my past life I didn't live in medieval Europe, or ancient Egypt, or some South Pacific paradise.
It was just a few decades ago...{p}

In my past life, I was an ordinary boy who lived in this town.
My family back then was my father, my mother, and one brother two years older than me...
My parents were busy and often away from home, so I was practically raised by that brother.
Unlike me, clumsy and painfully shy, my brother was bright and cheerful, the kind of person who'd end up at the center of every circle before you knew it.{p}
My brother's name was Soichiro.{p}

............Oh?
{a}...
Just now, the moment you heard my brother's name, you were a little startled, weren't you?
I was startled
No, I wasn't

...Ah, I thought so.
Is there something about my brother's name?{p}
I just thought it was a wonderful name...
I just thought it sounded nostalgic...
I just thought it was a frightening name...

Oh, so it feels nostalgic to you.
Isn't that surely because you had a deep connection with that name in your past life, {a}?
Perhaps you knew someone by that name...
Or perhaps you were called that yourself...
Of course, it's not an unusual name, so it wouldn't be the least bit strange if you knew someone with the same name in this life, either...{p}
...Let's get back to the story.{p}

My brother doted on me so much.
I always used to tag along after him.
Someone once told me I looked like a chick fresh out of the egg, trailing after the mother bird.
Looking back now, maybe it was said half in jest, but to me back then, it was nothing but the highest praise.
Just being by my brother's side made me happy.{p}

Of course...
I knew well enough that such happiness wouldn't last forever.
When you grow up, each of you has your own world, and it keeps growing wider.
Once that happens, you can't be together around the clock forever, the way you were as children...
Even so, those happy times should have lasted a while longer.
If only that incident had never happened...{p}

My brother was a second-year in high school.
I was a third-year in middle school.
Going home with my brother after school was my daily routine.
When my brother spotted me from his classroom window, he would wave to me with big sweeps of his arm.
That was the signal for 'I'll be right there.'
Once I saw it, I'd wave back just as big...
That was the signal for 'Got it.'{p}

That day, too, I was standing near the gate of the high school my brother went to.
I was watching the school building, waiting impatiently for my brother to show his face.
After a while, he appeared at the usual window.
Yes...
Even now, the image of my brother at that moment is burned vividly into the backs of my eyelids.{p}

A classroom on the top floor of the wooden school building...
At the third window from the right, my brother is waving with big sweeps of his arm.{p}

What a bright, refreshing smile it is...
The finest smile, meant for me alone.{p}

...The terrible tragedy happened right after that.
The very instant I tried to signal back...☆{p}
My brother's body pitched forward and was dashed straight into the ground!{p}

You see, to me as a middle schooler, the high school was a sacred place I could never set foot in.
I'd always believed I would only be allowed inside once I became a high school student myself.
Even after a wall of people surrounded my brother's body and I couldn't see it anymore, I couldn't take a single step from the school gate.
I was picturing the bright red blood gushing out of my brother's body...
The ground that soaked up my brother's blood still bears the mark today.{p}

Below the old school building... From here, it's hidden right behind the shrubbery.
I'm told it was a flowerbed, of sorts...
After my brother died, it became a bare patch of ground where neither flowers nor grass would grow.
Only the part that soaked up the blood has darkened like a stain, so you can easily make it out even from far away.
From my classroom, it's in plain view, though...{p}

...Ah, I forgot to mention.
My brother was a student at this school.
Of course, my past self intended to go on to this school too.
...But after my brother died, my health declined sharply...
I died before I could even graduate from middle school.
"They were such close brothers... his big brother must have called for him..."
People whispered that, though no one could say who started it.
In this life, the reason I came to this school was that I was curious about the school my brother once went to.
It's the place of memories that stays most deeply in my heart...
...Maybe I was searching for some trace of my brother.
You see, there was a place I'd made up my mind to visit as soon as I entered this school.
And that place was...{p}Where do you think it is?
The classroom where your brother was
The flowerbed that soaked up your brother's blood
The gate where you waited for your brother

...Yes.
As it happens, you're right.
It's the place where my brother met his final moment, the one I couldn't see that day...
I had wanted to visit the classroom where he'd been, too, but the old school building was off-limits.
I didn't think my brother would be pleased if I went so far as to break the rules...
So I headed to the flowerbed, thinking I could at least offer some flowers.{p}

Something is falling!
...That's what I felt.{p}

What met my eyes as I snapped them open was my brother, flung out into the air...
Without thinking, I spread my arms wide.
I was trying to catch my brother's body.
But his body vanished without ever touching my hands.
As if it had melted into the air.{p}

Wanting to let my brother rest in peace, I offered flowers and water almost every day and prayed with all my heart.
But it didn't seem to do any good at all.
My brother's ghost kept appearing almost every day.
Maybe there was some other cause behind this.
Was my brother trying to tell me something...?
That thought welled up in my mind.
And then, one day...!
I uncovered a crucial fact.{p}

At the instant my brother was flung into the air, two arms were reaching out of the classroom window...
The verdict on my brother's death, written off back then as an unfortunate accident, was in fact wrong.
Someone pushed my brother...
They were slender, white arms, so the one who pushed him was most likely a woman.{p}

...By the way, {a}?
You have a strange mark on your left hand, don't you?{p}

Three in a row... are those moles?
Yes, I noticed them when we shook hands earlier...
Did you know?
Normally, people shake hands with the right hand.
They say a left-handed handshake is the handshake for a farewell...
Well, that doesn't really have much to do with anything, but...
No... the truth is...{p}

The figure I saw also had three moles in a row on the left hand, just like you.
I could only see the hands, but I remember them clearly.{p}

{a}...
This is by no means a coincidence.
It's all a kind of karmic bond carried over from a past life.
I can see clearly who you were in your past life.
Shall I tell you?
Then I'm sure you'll remember too...
Please listen as well, everyone.{p}

In your past life, {a}, you were a girl named Kyoko Ichinose.
She was a childhood friend of us brothers, and ever since she was little, she'd adored my brother.
"I'm going to be Big Brother Soichiro's bride."
...That was what she always used to say.
She grew more beautiful day by day.
All just to become my brother's bride...{p}

...I suppose it was around the time she started middle school that her attitude became blatant...
Until then, the three of us did everything together, but she began openly ignoring me, and only me.
Was she trying to keep my brother all to herself?
But...
As I think I mentioned earlier, my brother loved me and doted on me more than anyone...
There was no way he'd fall for a girl who treated me so coldly.
In the end, her love went unrequited.
I think she pushed my brother to get back at him for that...
Yes, she was the one who killed my brother.{p}

...Oh?
What's the matter, {a}?
You're trembling so much...
And you look rather pale...{p}Was my story really that frightening?
It was scary
I'm not scared at all
I'm scared of you, Arai

But if I stay trapped in hatred forever, my brother will grieve.
He was a truly kind person...
If I were to kill you, it would only make him even sadder.
I could never do anything that cruel, you see.{p}

...That said, you mustn't let your guard down.
Listen to me.
You've been reborn in order to atone in this life for the sin you committed in your past one.
Let me see...
From now on, {a}, I'd like you to take my brother's place.
In place of my brother, the one you killed...{p}

...Still, it's a hot room, isn't it?
I'm getting rather thirsty.{p}At times like this, my brother would always go and buy me a cold juice...
